positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description:
* Design and implement test tools, written in Python
* Help implement a test framework, written in Java and TestNG
* Set up and maintain continuous build environments
* File & track defects until resolution 
* Install and maintain QA test environments which run on Linux OS 
* Perform builds and deployment to QA environments for weekly tests 
* Perform weekly performance testing
* Author several shell scripts (in bash) to facilitate weekly deployment processes 
* Author a Java tool to facilitate functional testing 
* Collaborate with developers and QA engineers to resolve bugs/issues 
* Author test plans and test cases in for several projects 
* File & track defects until resolution
